title: gh_comment.in_shared_root docstring points at tools/audit/prepr.sh, which is not in the tree
claim: The docstring of tools/pr/gh_comment.py:in_shared_root says `tools/audit/prepr.sh`'s `shared_root` is the same predicate; at the baseline tools/audit/prepr.sh does not exist and shared_root() is defined in tools/pr/prepr.sh.
mechanism: Fails D5-criteria.md C2 (precise: resolvable) and C1 (precise: true). A move (tests/layout.json: tools/audit/prepr.sh -> tools/pr/prepr.sh) left the twin-predicate pointer on the old path.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, finder fan-out running; a count is contention-immune

metric_definition: count of the file's D5 units (text_ledger.py units --dim D5) an executed check of the code contradicts (RESULT false_units_total with --file)
phenomenon_property: A comment naming a twin predicate names the file and function that define it at the ref.
